page.overview:
Who is Bastinardo of Tilea?

Not to be confused with Bastinado Garrotta Bastinardo of Tilea was a duke from the land of Tilea who was instrumental in the fate of the cowardly Count Ulrich von Schloss of the Reikland in his conflict with the Wood Elves of Athel Loren.

Duke Bastinardo of Tilea was contacted by Count Ulrich von Schloss of the Reikland with a request for crossbowmen in return for cannons from the Empire. Sadly Bastinardo had not been told that the cannons were defective.

Von Schloss made the request for Tilean troops not only to fight against the Bretonnians, but also to guide the count's army through Athel Loren to strike at the forces of the duke of Quenelles from an unexpected direction.

This was an unfortunate decision as the Wood Elves were no fairy tale and attacked the forces of von Schloss as they transited through the forest.
